tei:div.tei:p: 461) chos nyid mkha' 'gro'i thugs thig las: 'jam dpal mngon rtogs shes rab blo 'phel bzhugs: 462) na mo pad+ma kā ra ye: gang dag skal bar ldan pa yis: shes rab spobs pa'i gter 'chang ba: 'jam dpal ye shes sgrub pa'i thabs: yang zab snying po 'dir bstan bya: sa ma ya: sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes gsum las: dang po sngon 'gro skyabs sems ni:

na mo: bdag dang mtha' yas sems can kun: deng bzung byang chub ma thob bar: 'jam dpal dbyangs la skyabs su mchi: 'gro rnams ma rig las sgrol phyir: smon dang 'jug pa byang chub sems: dam pa bdag gis bskyed par bgyi: lan gsum brjod cing rang rgyud sbyangs: gnyis pa dngos gzhi bsgom pa ni: āḥ chos rnams rang bzhin stong pa nyid: stong nyid gdangs las snying rje'i rtsal: rgyu yi so bon 'phros pa las: bde chen 'gyur med zhing gi dbus: lhun grub gzhal yas bkod pa ngoms: de dbus skyon bral pad zla'i steng: rang nyid skad cig dran rdzogs su: 'jam dpal ye shes sems dpa'i sku: ma rig mun sel ser gsal mdzes: nyag gcig zhal dang mkhyen gnyis spyan: zung 'jug phyag gnyis g.yas pa yis: shes rab ral gri snyan thad 'dzin: g.yon pas thugs 463)kar ut+pa la: 'dab ma snyan thad gyes pa'i steng: zab rgya'i chos kyi glegs bam 'dzin: don gnyis snyan gyi pad+mo rgyas: bden gnyis shangs kyi dbyibs mdzes shing: mtshan bzang so gnyis tshems phreng dngar: longs sku 'gags med ljags pad srab: ye shes lhun rdzogs dbu skra bcings: 'gro kun rjes 'dzin zar bu 'khrol: srid zhi gnyis med zhabs gnyis kyis: rdo rje skyil krung pad zlar bzhugs: phyin drug mthar phyin rin chen gyi: dbu rgyan snyan cha mgul rgyan dang: longs spyod rdzogs pa'i chas kyis spras: yon tan yongs rdzogs dar snas brgyan: zhi 'dzum mtshan dang dpe byad ldan: ye shes 'ja' 'od 'khyil pa'i klong: snang stong sgyu ma'i sku ru bsgom: de ltar gsal ba'i gnas gsum las: 'od 'phros dbyings bzhugs rgyal ba dang: bla ma 'jam dpal rnam pa ru: spyan drangs dam ye dbyer med par: gnyis med ro gcig brtan par bzhugs: yongs grub rig pas phyag 'tshal lo: phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa'i tshogs: 464) dkyil 'khor lha tshogs dgyes phyir 'bul: ji lta ji snyed mkhyen cing gzigs:

gzung spobs blo gros kun gyi mdzod: rgyal kun mkhyen brtse'i ye shes 'chang: 'jam dpal ye shes sems dpar bstod: ma rig 'khrul pa'i dbang song bas: gnyis 'dzin sems kyi sgrib pa bshags: badz+ra sa ma ya shud+dhe āḥ rang nyid 'jam dpal thugs ka ru: pad+ma zla ba'i lte ba ru: gser gyi 'khor lo rtsibs drug pa'i: lte bar ral gri'i khong gseng du: dhīḥyig gser gyi mdog can la: rtsa ba'i sngags kyis g.yas su bskor: 'od 'phros rgyal mchod byin rlabs bsdus: mar 'phros 'gro ba'i sgrib pa sbyangs: tshe bsod dpal yon nus pa dang: 'byung lnga'i dwangs bcud ma lus pa: 'od kyi rnam par tshur bsdus bstims: 'khor 'das yongs kyi srog thob bsam: oṃ a ra pa tsa na dhīḥ ces pa bsnyen pa'i man ngag go: slar yang dhīḥlas 'od 'phros pas: rgyal kun gsang gsum mnyes mchod 'bul: mkhyen brtse nus byin dpal yon tan: 'od lnga'i rnam par rang la thim: gzungs spobs bla gros dbang thob nas: shes rab snang ba rgyas par bsam: oṃ a ra pa 465)tsa na dhīḥ zhes bzla sgrub ba'i las rim mo: oṃ ni rgyal kun gsang gsum rdzogs: sku dang ye shes yon tan dpal: dbang dang byin rlabs kun gyi mdzod: a ni chos kun snying por dril: skye 'gags 'gyur med spros bral dbyings: chos rnams kun gyi 'byung gnas che: ra yis ma rig drwa ba gcod: smra ngan sgol ba tshar bcad nas: spobs pa'i gter brgyad kun thob 'gyur: pa yis mkhyen brtse'i ye shes dang: shes rab snang ba mchog thob nas: ma rig blo yi mun pa sel: tsa yis gzungs kyi sgo 'phar 'byed: shes bya'i chos kun rab tu gsal: bden don mngon par mkhyen pa'o: na yis srid pa'i rtsa ba gcod: sgrib gnyis dri ma dbyings su sangs: shes rab gsum gyi snang ba thob: dhīḥni srid zhi kun gyi srog: ji lta ji snyed mkhyen cing gzigs: snying po bcud dril 'di kho na:

rnam gnyis dngos grub 'byung ba'i gnas: 'di nyid gcig pur gnad dril na: mgon po kun gzigs go 'phang la: ring por mi lon tshe 'dir grol: gsang ba shes rab rtsa 'byed thabs: man ngan zung 'jug yig 'bru ni: dhīḥser khong gseng hrīṃ yig sngo: dwangs gsal spu yis bris ltar gsal: bzlas dmigs gnad la gzir ba la: srog gi yang snying 'bru gcig ni: rang nyid lhar gsal thugs ka ru: dhīḥyig 466) hrīḥgis mtshan pa bsgom: de las 'od 'phros rgyal rnams dang: paṇ+ḍi ta dang mkhas grub sogs: smra ba'i dbang po thams cad kyi: shes rab gzungs spobs blo gros kun: ser gsal 'od kyi rnam pa ru: tshur bsdus rang gi thugs srog la: chu la chu bzhag ji bzhin du: gnyis med ro gcig 'dres bsam zhing: yengs med snying po 'di bzlas bya: dhī hrīṃḥ zhes pa dus drug chags med bya: de yis dbu mgrin rtsa skyon sel: shes rab che zhing gzungs spobs thob: skabs su nya stong dus drug gamaḥ nyi zla sgra gcan dang 'phrad dus: lhag pa'i lha la 'dod gsol ni: hoḥ 'jam dpal smra ba'i dbang phyug khyod kyis bdag la don rab mkhyen pa'i ye shes: mi brjed pa'i gzungs: chags thogs med pa'i shes rab: zil gyis mi non pa'i spobs pa: 'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i blo gros: 'gro ba'i mun sel gyi thugs rje: mdor na rig pa'i gnas lnga la dbang 'byor zhing: lung dang rtogs pa'i gzhung don ma lus bdag gi khong du chud nas tshe 'di nyid la don gnyis kyi mdzad pa mthar phyin te nang gsal 'jam dpal dpa' bo'i go 'phang thob par mdzad du gsol: ces dang: rtsa sngags snying po ci 'grub dang: lce zla gdan la bsgom pa'i steng du dhīḥhrīṃ 467) gsal la: ngag nas brjod bzhin dmigs gnad la yengs med bya'o: de ni las sbyor rim pa'o: sa ma ya: gsum pa rjes rim ni: nyer spyod kyis mchod la bstod pa ni: dhīḥ dmar ser nyi ma 'char ka'i mdangs bkra ba:

ut+pal steng na ral gri po ti 'dzin: bcu phrag bcu dang bcu gnyis rgyan gyis spras: 'jam dpal smra ba'i dbang po khyod la bstod: dge ba 'di yis 'jam dpal dbyangs 'grub nas: shes rab mchog gi spobs pa rab thob cing: mgon po kun gzigs mchog gi go 'phang la: rang gzhan 'gro kun ma lus spyod gyur cig: de ltar tshul bzhin nyams blangs na: shes rab snang ba rab rgyas nas: gzungs spobs blo gros thob par ngesaḥ tshe 'dir don gnyis ngang gis 'byung: the tshom med do sa ma ya: de la brten nas tshogs mchod ni: ci 'byor pa yi zas sna bsags: yang na bza' tshogs byed kyang rung: ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ gis mi gtsang sbyangs: oṃ āḥhūṃ gis bdud rtsir bsgyur: rang nyid lha yi ting 'dzin gyis: ram̐ yam̐ kham̐: oṃ āḥhūm̐: snang ba snod kyi ka pā lar: snod bcud 'dod yon tshogs su bshams: ye shes bdud rtsir byin gyis brlabs: zag med bde stong bskyed 468)pa'i rdzas: rtsa gsum rgyal ba rgya mtsho dang: 'jam dpal dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul: bdag cag bsod nams rdzogs phyir bzhes: thugs dam bskang la nyams chags bshags: gzung 'dzin dbyings bsgral lhag med rol: gsang ba mchog gi dngos grub stsol: lhag skyong mgron rnams lhag gtor bzhes: phyi nang bar chad dbyings su bzlog: u ts+tshiṣ+ṭa bā liṃ ta khā hiḥ chad don la gnas srung ma dang: ma yams bstan ma ya ma'i tshogs: dam tshig gsang ba'i gtor ma longs: phrin las rab 'byams lhun grub mdzod: ma rig gnyis snang ru tra brub: ldang med ye shes rol pas mnan: phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa'i tshogs: 'jam dpal dkyil 'khor dgyes phyir mchod: rang byung lhan skyes ye shes lha: rgyal ba'i sku gsung thugs la bstod: mchog thun dngos grub deng 'dir stsol: sarba sid+dhi pha la hoḥ lha sngags ting 'dzin g.yel ba bshags: sa ma ya shud+dhe āḥ dge 'di 'gro ba yongs la bsngo: kun kyang sangs rgyas sa thob shog:

thabs kyis bskyed pa'i dkyil 'khor lha: shes rab rig ba'i klong du āḥ slar yang rjes thob lha skur gsal: 469) dhīḥdhīḥdhīḥ sa gsum dge ba'i bkra shis gang: bdag cag rnams la bde legs shog: tshogs mchod phul ba'i bsod nams kyis: bdag gzhan 'gro ba ma lus pa: dam pa sku gnyis thob pa dang: mngon gyur dang po'i sa thob shog: de yis tshogs rdzogs sgrib dag nas: tshe 'dir don gnyis dpal thob nges: sa ma ya: de la brten nas me tshogs ni: du ba med pa'i me dkyil du: dkar gsum dang ni mngar gsum dang: 'dab ldan me tog ser po'i rigs: sman sna la sogs rdzas su bsags: yang na me tog ser po dang: ci 'byor pa yi rdzas bsags nas: me thab dmigs med stong pa gyur: stong pa'i ngang las skad cig gis: mkha' la 'ja' tshon shar ba bzhin: bde chen 'gyur med zhing khams su: bkod pa rab rdzogs gzhal yas dbus: pad+ma zla ba rgyas pa'i steng: mdun bskyed ye shes sems dpa' ni: 'jam dpal dmar ser gur gum mdog: phyag gnyis ral gri po sti 'dzin: zhal gcig 'dzum pa'i mdangs dang ldan: spyan gnyis 'gro la brtse bar gzigs: dbu skra thod bcings zar bu grol: longs spyod rgyan rdzogs zhi tshul 470)ldan: ye shes 'od lnga'i klong dkyil du: zhabs gnyis rdo rje'i skyil krung bzhugs: snang stong sgyu ma'i sku ru gsal: ljags steng raṃ las 'od byung bas: sreg rdzas ye shes bdud rtsi'i bcud: zag med bde ba chen por rol: dgyes tshim tshogs rdzogs sgrib kun sbyangs: mi shes rmongs pa rab bsal nas: blo gros spobs pa'i dngos grub stsol: oṃ gu ru ar+ya mañdzu shrī ma hā sarba pañtsa pū dza la khā hiḥ rnal 'byor pa bdag la shes rab phun sum tshogs pa bstsal du gsol: ces grangs ldan phul mthar bsngo smon ni: bla ma 'jam dpal dkyil 'khor du: sreg blugs mchod pa phul ba'i dge: 'gro kun sangs rgyas thob phyir bsngo:

bdag cag sems can ma lus pa: mkhyen gzigs ye shes mngon gyur nas: gzhon nu bum skur sangs rgyas shog: lha nyid 'od zhu rang la thim: dmigs med chos kyi dbyings su a: bdag snang dam tshig sems dpa' ni: rjes thob sgyu ma'i lha ru ldang: srid las rnam rgyal nyon mongs med: sku gsum lhun grub bkra shis shog: ces dang: gzhan yang bkra shis smon lam brjod: de yis las rnams gang 'dod kyi: dmigs pa'i lde kha bsgyur mkhas na: mda' la 471) mde'u gdags pa bzhin: 'dod don phrin las ngang gis 'grub: man ngag zab gnad kun gyi bcud: pad 'byung thugs bcud zab mo 'di: gces nor tshul du brda ru btab: ma 'ongs snyigs ma snyigs ma'i dus: gter min zob brdzus sa steng khyab: chos dang chos min 'byed par dka': 'gro ba'i blo sems bdud kyis bsgyur: pad 'byung sprul pas gdul dka' 'byung: chos bzhin spyod pa nyin skar tsam: bskyed rdzogs gding dang ldan par dka': zab mo'i don rnams khyim par 'chad: rtsa rlung ltad mo'i gnas su mngon: bdud sprul smon lam mthu btsan pas: bstan gnyis ya ma zung du grub: mi rnams blo sems bdud kyis bslus: mtha' mi 'bod pa rang gis byed: mi 'dod nad mtshon mu ge dar: dmag 'khrugs dus ngan rang rtags ngoms: smad kyi du ba stod du 'phyur: nub kyi khu 'phang phyogs phyogs 'thor: sdig spyod skyes bus dben phrod 'dzin: sgrub brgyud bstan pa dbang gzhur 'gran: de 'dra'i dus ngan shar ba'i tshe: pad 'byung thugs rjes ma skyob na: bod khams seng khog srin zhugs 'dra: de phyir mtsho rgyal bdag nyid kyi: thugs dam spros med zab gnad 'di: a tsar sā le khyod la gdams: da dung ma spel gter rgyas thobs: ma 'ongs snyigs ma'i dus kyi tshe: nga min nga yi sprul pa ni: thugs kyi ming can sbas tshul 'dzin: 472) nub nas shar du rgyu pa 'byung: (Dakini secret letter

here) thabs grogs nam snying bi ma la: chos bdag bcu gsum dus su 'aprad: (Dakini secret letter here) 'gro don bstan pa rim gyis dar: gcig brgyud gyis l nyams su longs: shes rab ye shes rtsal 'bar zhing: dbu mgrin rtsa mdud rang grol nas: snang srid brda dper 'char ba dang: lhag pa'i lha yis rjes bzung nges: bden brdzun lag tu longs dang gsal: skal ldan bu dang 'phrad par shog: log lta can la 'di ma 'phrad: bka' srung dregs pa'i tshogs kyis gnyer: the tshom can gyi dbang po snubs: dam nyams lag tu ma shor bar: thub par srungs shig sa ma ya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: brda thim: zhes pa 'di'ang mchog gi rig pa 'dzin pa chen po snga 'gyur bstan pa'i nyi ma zhabs drung skyabs mgon rin po che'i zhal snga nas dgos zhes srid du ring ba'i bkra shis lha reg dkar po dang*/ sa bcu lam lnga'i mtshon don rten 'brel gyi rdzas dang: nang don ye shes mtshon phyir rin po che rnam gsum bcas bka' bskul spyi bor phebs tshe bzlog ma nus par dbyings snang mkha' 'gro'i brda ris las dbyi shod ri che'i gdan sa chen po'i nye char/ lha brag rin chen rdzong gi de 'dabs o rgyan phug nas bde chen bde ba'i rdo rjes nyams chos yig ris su bris pa'o// dge'o//
